maria: kicking off RC creation for release candidate rc-2026-04-06, artifact: registry.redwood/infra:rc-2026-04-06-7a2b
maria: main change is the KV migration and a small runtime kernel tweak. need pin + signoff from ops and qa before promo. @ops-oncall fyi: db migration window at 03:00 UTC
maria: also requesting migration hold flag so we don't promote during the migration window
deploy-bot: build 7a2b completed — checksum abc123
deploy-bot: canary plan: 5% traffic for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> 100% if no errors
taylor: I can take sheriff for promo if ops gives green
sam: running smoke now on staging, will post results in ~5m
lee: quick telemetry sanity peek: p95 latency delta +1ms on staging, no obvious errors
sam: smoke PASS: core endpoints returning 200, KV warm ok, leak test clears
ops-oncall: +1 for pin but hold on promo until migration finishes. we need explicit "migration_hold": true in the promo request and a rollback owner assigned
maria: understood. setting migration_hold. assigning rollback owner @taylor
maria: pin request: registry.redwood/infra:rc-2026-04-06-7a2b -> pinned to candidate slot
deploy-bot: executing pin: `pin-artifact --env candidate --artifact registry.redwood/infra:rc-2026-04-06-7a2b`
deploy-bot: pin successful, candidate slot now serving artifact rc-2026-04-06-7a2b
taylor: rollback plan: revert to rc-2026-04-05-6f1c (previous candidate). Rollback script: `deploy rollback --to rc-2026-04-05-6f1c --force-after 3m`
ops-oncall: rollback owner acknowledged. migration_hold is ON. do not promote until window clears and I post "migration_clear"
maria: tagging release-notes owners to prepare final notes. @lee can you add the KV migration caveat
lee: will add note: "KV migration will run during quiet window; expect transient 503s for keys that are evicted and repopulated"
sam: scheduling a quick post-deploy smoke run after promo to validate warmed kvs and runtime kernels
taylor: when ops posts migration_clear I will initiate deploybot promo: `deploybot promote --from candidate --to prod --staged 5,25,100 --migration-hold true`
deploy-bot: promo command queued (awaiting migration_clear). logs will be in /deploy/logs/rc-6298765432
maria: thanks all — keeping this channel for promo updates only. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: migration_clear posted at 6298765499 — go for promo when ready
taylor: starting promotion now
deploy-bot: promo started: 5% -> 25% -> 100% per plan
deploy-bot: promo completed successfully. final artifact live in prod: registry.redwood/infra:rc-2026-04-06-7a2b
maria: promoted and monitoring. closing thread after 30m stable window
lee: noted for release notes and postmortem checklist
